articles.title_en: Economic Sanctions: Evolution, Consequences, and Challenges
articles.title_cn: 经济制裁：演变、后果与挑战
articles.abstract_en: Taking an interdisciplinary perspective, we examine the evolution of economic sanctions in the post-World War II era and reflect on the lessons that could be drawn from their features and patterns of use. We observe that, during this time, there has been a remarkable increase in the use of sanctions as an instrument of foreign policy. We classify this period into four ‘eras’ and discuss, in this context, how the evolution of sanctions may be linked to salient features of the contemporaneous international political and economic orders. Our review of the related literatures in economics and political science suggests, among other things, that our understanding of sanction processes could be significantly advanced by marrying these perspectives. We conclude by identifying several questions and challenges, and by discussing how interdisciplinary research could address them.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们采取跨学科的视角，考察了二战后经济制裁的演变，并反思了从其特征和使用模式中可能汲取的教训。我们观察到，在此期间，制裁作为外交政策工具的使用显著增加。我们将这一时期划分为四个“时代”，并在此背景下讨论制裁的演变如何与同时期国际政治和经济秩序的显著特征相关联。我们对经济学和政治学相关文献的回顾表明，除其他外，通过结合这些视角，我们对制裁过程的理解可以得到显著推进。最后，我们指出了几个问题和挑战，并讨论了跨学科研究如何应对这些挑战。

articles.title_en: Financial Sanctions, SWIFT, and the Architecture of the International Payment System
articles.title_cn: 金融制裁、SWIFT与国际支付体系架构
articles.abstract_en: Financial sanctions, alongside economic sanctions, are components of the toolkit used by governments as part of international diplomacy. The use of sanctions, especially financial, has increased over the last 70 years. Financial sanctions have been particularly important whenever the goals of the sanctioning countries were related to democracy and human rights. Financial sanctions restrict entities—countries, businesses, or even individuals—from purchasing or selling financial assets, or from accessing custodial or other financial services. They can be imposed on a sanctioned entity’s ability to access the infrastructures that are in place to execute international payments, irrespective of whether such payments underpin financial or real activity. This article explains how financial sanctions can be designed to limit access to the international payment system and, in particular, the SWIFT network, and provides some recent examples.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融制裁与经济制裁一样，是政府在国际外交中使用的工具之一。制裁的使用，尤其是金融制裁，在过去70年中有所增加。每当制裁国家的目标与民主和人权相关时，金融制裁尤为重要。金融制裁限制实体——国家、企业甚至个人——购买或出售金融资产，或获取托管或其他金融服务。它们可以施加于受制裁实体进入执行国际支付的现有基础设施的能力，无论这些支付是否支撑金融或实体活动。本文解释了金融制裁如何被设计以限制进入国际支付体系，特别是SWIFT网络，并提供了一些近期例子。

articles.title_en: Monetary Policy When the Central Bank Shapes Financial-Market Sentiment
articles.title_cn: 当中央银行塑造金融市场情绪时的货币政策
articles.abstract_en: Recent research has found that monetary policy works in part by influencing the risk premiums on both traded financial-market securities and intermediated loans. Research has also shown that when risk premiums are compressed, there is an increased likelihood of a reversal that damages the credit-supply mechanism and the real economy. Together these effects create an intertemporal tradeoff for monetary policy, as stimulating the economy today can sow the seeds of a future downturn that might be difficult to offset. We draw out some implications of this tradeoff for the conduct of monetary policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期研究发现，货币政策在一定程度上通过影响交易性金融市场证券和中介贷款的风险溢价来发挥作用。研究还表明，当风险溢价被压缩时，出现逆转的可能性增加，这会损害信贷供给机制和实体经济。这些效应共同为货币政策创造了一个跨期权衡，因为今天刺激经济可能为未来难以抵消的衰退埋下种子。我们阐述了这一权衡对货币政策实施的一些启示。

articles.title_en: Risk Appetite and the Risk-Taking Channel of Monetary Policy
articles.title_cn: 风险偏好与货币政策的风险承担渠道
articles.abstract_en: Monetary policy affects financial markets and the broader economy in part by changing the risk appetite of investors. This article provides new evidence for this so-called risk-taking channel of monetary policy by revisiting and extending event-study analysis of Federal Open Market Committee announcements. We document significant effects of unexpected monetary policy changes on risk indicators drawn from equity, fixed-income, credit, and foreign exchange markets. We develop a new index of risk appetite based on the common component of these indicators. Surprise monetary easing leads to strong and persistent increases in our index, and vice versa for tightening surprises, consistent with the view that monetary policy affects asset prices in large part through its effects on risk appetite. We discuss the implications of the risk-taking channel for monetary policy transmission, optimal monetary policy, and financial stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 货币政策通过改变投资者的风险偏好，在一定程度上影响金融市场和整体经济。本文通过重新审视并扩展联邦公开市场委员会公告的事件研究分析，为所谓的货币政策风险承担渠道提供了新的证据。我们记录了意外的货币政策变化对来自股票、固定收益、信贷和外汇市场的风险指标的显著影响。我们基于这些指标的共同成分开发了一个新的风险偏好指数。意外的货币宽松导致我们的指数强劲且持续上升，而紧缩的意外则相反，这与货币政策在很大程度上通过其对风险偏好的影响来影响资产价格的观点一致。我们讨论了风险承担渠道对货币政策传导、最优货币政策和金融稳定的影响。

articles.title_en: Landings, Soft and Hard: The Federal Reserve, 1965–2022
articles.title_cn: 软着陆与硬着陆：美联储，1965-2022
articles.abstract_en: “Soft landings,” that is, cases in which the central bank tightens monetary policy to fight inflation but does not cause a recession (which would be a “hard landing”, are thought to be difficult to achieve and extremely rare. According to the conventional wisdom, the Federal Reserve has managed to achieve only one soft landing in the past 60 years—in 1994–1995. This paper studies the eleven episodes of monetary policy tightening by the Fed since 1965, and concludes that the central bank has a better record than that—that as long as the criteria for softness are not too stringent, and Fed was actually trying to land the economy softly, the Fed has succeeded several times. Achieving a soft landing, however, requires both skill in managing monetary policy and the absence of adverse external shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: “软着陆”，即中央银行收紧货币政策以对抗通胀但未导致衰退（衰退则为“硬着陆”）的情况，被认为难以实现且极为罕见。传统观点认为，美联储在过去60年中仅成功实现过一次软着陆——即在1994-1995年。本文研究了自1965年以来美联储的十一次货币政策收紧事件，并得出结论：美联储的实际记录优于上述观点——只要软着陆的标准不过于严苛，且美联储确实在努力使经济软着陆，那么美联储已多次成功。然而，实现软着陆既需要货币政策管理的技巧，也需要避免不利的外部冲击。

articles.abstract_en: We ask three questions about the connection between monetary policy and inequality. First, does monetary policy affect inequality? While different households respond to changes in monetary policy for different reasons, we argue that the overall consumption effects are relatively evenly distributed across households. Second, does household heterogeneity change our understanding of monetary policy transmission? A more careful account of microeconomic consumption behavior materially alters our understanding of transmission channels, but has rather limited effect on our general view of the aggregate effects of monetary policy. Third, does inequality affect the optimal conduct of monetary policy? Since monetary policy is a rather blunt distributional tool, we argue that even a central bank with an explicit distributional mandate would not deviate much from conventional policy prescriptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出关于货币政策与不平等之间联系的三个问题。首先，货币政策是否影响不平等？虽然不同家庭因不同原因对货币政策变化作出反应，但我们认为总体消费效应在家庭间分布相对均匀。其次，家庭异质性是否改变了我们对货币政策传导的理解？对微观经济消费行为更细致的考量实质上改变了我们对传导渠道的理解，但对货币政策总体效应的普遍看法影响相当有限。第三，不平等是否影响最优货币政策的制定？由于货币政策是一种相当粗略的分配工具，我们认为即使是一个具有明确分配任务的中央银行也不会偏离传统政策建议太多。

articles.title_cn: 解析西班牙裔健康悖论
articles.abstract_en: In 2019, Hispanics in the US had a life expectancy advantage of 3.0 years and 7.1 years over non-Hispanic Whites and non-Hispanic Blacks, respectively, despite having real-household income values 26 percentage points lower than Non-Hispanic White households. Hispanics appear to have equal or even better health outcomes relative to non-Hispanic Whites across various health measures. This is known as the Hispanic health paradox. This paper underscores the importance of disaggregating Hispanics by ancestry and age profile when discussing the paradox across key health outcomes. It also provides an overview of the leading explanations, such as the salmon bias and the healthy immigrant effect. Further, it highlights the role of healthcare access and usage in this discussion. Ignoring these sources of bias have important consequences for how morbidity and mortality among Hispanics are measured within widely used national datasets.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2019年，美国西班牙裔人的预期寿命比非西班牙裔白人和非西班牙裔黑人分别高出3.0年和7.1年，尽管其实际家庭收入值比非西班牙裔白人家庭低26个百分点。在各种健康指标上，西班牙裔人相对于非西班牙裔白人似乎拥有相同甚至更好的健康结果。这被称为西班牙裔健康悖论。本文强调了在讨论关键健康结果中的悖论时，按祖籍和年龄特征对西班牙裔人进行细分的重要性。文章还概述了主要解释，如鲑鱼偏倚和健康移民效应。此外，文章强调了医疗保健获取和使用在这一讨论中的作用。忽视这些偏倚来源对于在广泛使用的国家数据集中衡量西班牙裔人的发病率和死亡率具有重要影响。

articles.title_en: Hispanic Americans in the Labor Market: Patterns over Time and across Generations
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场中的西班牙裔美国人：跨时间与跨代的模式
articles.abstract_en: This article reviews evidence on the labor market performance of Hispanics in the United States, with a particular focus on the US-born segment of this population. After discussing critical issues that arise in the US data sources commonly used to study Hispanics, we document how Hispanics currently compare with other Americans in terms of education, earnings, and labor supply, and then we discuss long-term trends in these outcomes. Relative to non-Hispanic Whites, US-born Hispanics from most national origin groups possess sizeable deficits in earnings, which in large part reflect corresponding educational deficits. Over time, rates of high school completion by US-born Hispanics have almost converged to those of non-Hispanic Whites, but the large Hispanic deficits in college completion have instead widened. Finally, from the perspective of immigrant generations, Hispanics experience substantial improvements in education and earnings between first-generation immigrants and the second-generation consisting of the US-born children of immigrants. Continued progress beyond the second generation is obscured by measurement issues arising from high rates of Hispanic intermarriage and the fact that later-generation descendants of Hispanic immigrants often do not self-identify as Hispanic when they come from families with mixed ethnic origins.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文回顾了关于美国西班牙裔劳动力市场表现的证据，特别关注这一人群中美国出生的部分。在讨论了美国常用数据源中研究西班牙裔时出现的关键问题后，我们记录了西班牙裔目前在教育、收入和工作供给方面与其他美国人的比较情况，然后讨论了这些结果的长期趋势。相对于非西班牙裔白人，来自大多数原籍国的美国出生西班牙裔在收入上存在相当大的差距，这很大程度上反映了相应的教育差距。随着时间的推移，美国出生的西班牙裔高中毕业率几乎与非西班牙裔白人趋同，但西班牙裔在大学毕业方面的巨大差距反而扩大了。最后，从移民代际的角度来看，西班牙裔在第一代移民与由移民的美国出生子女组成的第二代之间经历了教育和收入的显著改善。第二代之后的持续进步被西班牙裔高比例的族际通婚以及后来几代西班牙裔移民后裔在来自混合族裔背景家庭时往往不自我认同为西班牙裔这一事实所导致的测量问题所掩盖。

articles.title_en: US Immigration from Latin America in Historical Perspective
articles.title_cn: 历史视角下的拉丁美洲移民美国
articles.abstract_en: The share of US residents who were born in Latin America and the Caribbean plateaued recently, after a half century of rapid growth. Our review of the evidence on the US immigration wave from the region suggests that it bears many similarities to the major immigration waves of the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, that the demographic and economic forces behind Latin American migrant inflows appear to have weakened across most sending countries, and that a continued slowdown of immigration from Latin America post-pandemic has the potential to disrupt labor-intensive sectors in many US regional labor markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 在经历了半个世纪的快速增长后，出生于拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的美国居民占比近期趋于平稳。我们对来自该地区的美国移民浪潮证据的回顾表明，它与十九世纪和二十世纪初的主要移民浪潮有许多相似之处，拉丁美洲移民流入背后的人口和经济力量在大多数输出国似乎已经减弱，并且疫情后拉丁美洲移民持续放缓有可能扰乱美国许多地区劳动力市场中的劳动密集型行业。

articles.title_en: Oleg Itskhoki: 2022 John Bates Clark Medalist
articles.title_cn: 奥列格·伊茨霍基：2022年约翰·贝茨·克拉克奖得主
articles.abstract_en: The 2022 John Bates Clark Medal of the American Economic Association was awarded to Oleg Itskhoki, Professor of Economics at the University of California, Los Angeles for his path breaking contributions in international economics. This article summarizes Oleg Itskhoki’s work and places it in the context of the broader literature and emphasizes how it has shed new light on a number of long-standing puzzles regarding the behavior of exchange rates and international relative prices more generally and their connection to macroeconomic fluctuations and government’s choices of monetary and fiscal policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国经济学会将2022年约翰·贝茨·克拉克奖授予加州大学洛杉矶分校经济学教授奥列格·伊茨霍基，以表彰他在国际经济学领域的开创性贡献。本文总结了奥列格·伊茨霍基的研究工作，并将其置于更广泛的文献背景中，强调他的研究如何为关于汇率和国际相对价格行为的一系列长期存在的谜题提供了新的解释，以及这些行为与宏观经济波动和政府货币政策与财政政策选择之间的联系。
